title: Testing the max-flow min-cut property and the replication conjecture
summary: The replication conjecture [Conforti and Cornuéjols, 1993] states that every clutter with the packing property has the MFMC property. If true, this conjecture would have far-reaching consequences from integer programming and combinatorial optimization to commutative algebra. In this paper, we set out to verify the conjecture for the cuboid of a set-system in which the Hamming graph induced on the infeasible points has degree at most $δ$.
